description: This source file contains utility functions for manipulating WebKit WK types such as WKArray and WKString within the WebKitBrowser project, providing conversions between WK types and std::string, as well as array manipulation functions.

methods.name: AppendStringToWKArray
methods.description: Adds a std::string as a WKString to a WKMutableArray.

methods.name: GetStringFromWKArray
methods.description: Retrieves a std::string from a WKArray at a specified index.

methods.name: WKStringToString
methods.description: Converts a WKStringRef to a std::string.

methods.name: ConvertWKArrayToStringVector
methods.description: Converts a WKArrayRef of WKStringRef items to a vector of std::strings.
